##### Project general facts

Vida Hotels and Resorts is a contemporary lifestyle hospitality and branded residential concept under Emaar Hospitality Group, representing a fresh interpretation of modern luxury living. Designed for a new generation that values simplicity, energy, and connection, VIDA blends stylish design with a relaxed, youthful atmosphere. Its philosophy is rooted in warmth and understated sophistication, creating spaces that feel both vibrant and effortlessly refined.

The brand is known for its thoughtfully curated environments that combine modern technology, intuitive services, and engaging social spaces. VIDA developments are designed to encourage interaction, creativity, and wellbeing, offering residents and guests a lifestyle that goes beyond traditional hospitality. Every detail is crafted to enhance daily living, making comfort and experience equally important.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, characterized by clean lines, neutral tones, and a fresh, contemporary aesthetic. Spaces are designed to feel bright and inviting, with a focus on comfort and functional elegance. The kitchens are equipped with appliances, and the residences are offered fully furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the vibrant heart of the city and one of its most iconic and prestigious districts. Home to world-famous landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, the area represents the pinnacle of modern urban living, combining luxury residences, hospitality, retail, and entertainment in one dynamic destination.

The district is designed around a pedestrian-friendly lifestyle, featuring wide boulevards, landscaped walkways, and the stunning Burj Lake waterfront promenade. Residents and visitors enjoy a constant flow of world-class dining, cultural attractions such as Dubai Opera, and iconic experiences like the Dubai Fountain show, creating a lively atmosphere day and night.

With its central location along Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai offers seamless connectivity to key business and leisure hubs across the city. Its unmatched mix of skyline views, premium amenities, and vibrant city energy makes it one of the most desirable and recognizable addresses in the world.
